phrasing: deterministic labels; verbatim pinned definitions and usage notes

entries.need: Identify and describe an identifier.
entries.label: identifier

entries.need: Find the notation of an identifier.
entries.label: notation

entries.need: Identify and describe a catalog.
entries.label: catalog

entries.need: Find the dataset of a catalog.
entries.label: dataset
usage_notes: This property links the Catalogue with a Dataset that is part of the Catalogue.

entries.need: Find the record of a catalog.
entries.label: record
usage_notes: This property refers to a Catalogue Record that is part of the Catalogue

entries.need: Find the themes of a catalog.
entries.label: themes
usage_notes: This property refers to a knowledge organization system used to classify the Catalogue's Datasets.

entries.need: Find the description of a catalog.
entries.label: description
usage_notes: This property contains a free-text account of the Catalogue. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description. For further information on multilingual issues, please refer to section 8.

entries.need: Find the has part of a catalog.
entries.label: has part
usage_notes: This property refers to a related Catalogue that is part of the described Catalogue

entries.need: Find the is part of of a catalog.
entries.label: is part of
usage_notes: This property refers to a related Catalogue in which the described Catalogue is physically or logically included.

entries.need: Find the release date of a catalog.
entries.label: release date

entries.need: Find the language of a catalog.
entries.label: language
usage_notes: This property refers to a language used in the textual metadata describing titles, descriptions, etc. of the Datasets in the Catalogue. This property can be repeated if the metadata is provided in multiple languages.

entries.need: Find the licence of a catalog.
entries.label: licence
usage_notes: This property refers to the licence under which the Catalogue can be used or reused.

entries.need: Find the update/ of a catalog.
entries.label: update/

entries.need: Find the publisher of a catalog.
entries.label: publisher
usage_notes: This property refers to an entity (organisation) responsible for making the Catalogue available.

entries.need: Find the rights of a catalog.
entries.label: rights
usage_notes: This property refers to a statement that specifies rights associated with the Catalogue.

entries.need: Find the spatial / of a catalog.
entries.label: spatial /
usage_notes: This property refers to a geographical area covered by the Catalogue.

entries.need: Find the title of a catalog.
entries.label: title
usage_notes: This property contains a name given to the Catalogue. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the name.

entries.need: Find the homepage of a catalog.
entries.label: homepage
usage_notes: This property refers to a web page that acts as the main page for the Catalogue.

entries.need: Identify and describe a catalog record.
entries.label: catalog record

entries.need: Find the change type of a catalog record.
entries.label: change type
usage_notes: This property refers to the type of the latest revision of a Dataset's entry in the Catalogue. It MUST take one of the values :created, :updated or :deleted depending on whether his latest revision is a result of a creation, update or deletion.

entries.need: Find the application of a catalog record.
entries.label: application
usage_notes: This property refers to an Application Profile hat the Dataset’s metadata conforms to

entries.need: Find the description of a catalog record.
entries.label: description
usage_notes: This property contains a free-text account of the record. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description.

entries.need: Find the listing date of a catalog record.
entries.label: listing date
usage_notes: This property contains the date on which the description of the Dataset was included in the Catalogue.

entries.need: Find the language of a catalog record.
entries.label: language
usage_notes: This property refers to a language used in the textual metadata describing titles, descriptions, etc. of the Dataset. This property can be repeated if the metadata is provided in multiple languages.

entries.need: Find the update/ of a catalog record.
entries.label: update/
usage_notes: This property contains the most recent date on which the Catalogue entry was changed or modified.

entries.need: Find the source metadata of a catalog record.
entries.label: source metadata
usage_notes: This property refers to the original metadata that was used in creating metadata for the Dataset

entries.need: Find the title of a catalog record.
entries.label: title
usage_notes: This property contains a name given to the Catalogue Record. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the name.

entries.need: Find the primary of a catalog record.
entries.label: primary
usage_notes: This property links the Catalogue Record to the Dataset described in the record.

entries.need: Identify and describe a dataset.
entries.label: dataset

entries.need: Find the other identifier of a dataset.
entries.label: other identifier
usage_notes: This property refers to a secondary identifier of the Dataset, such as MAST/ADS18, DataCite19, DOI20, EZID21 or W3ID22.

entries.need: Find the sample of a dataset.
entries.label: sample
usage_notes: This property refers to a sample distribution of the dataset

entries.need: Find the version notes of a dataset.
entries.label: version notes
usage_notes: This property contains a description of the differences between this version and a previous version of the Dataset. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the version notes.

entries.need: Find the contact point of a dataset.
entries.label: contact point
usage_notes: This property contains contact information that can be used for sending comments about the Dataset.

entries.need: Find the dataset of a dataset.
entries.label: dataset
usage_notes: This property links the Dataset to an available Distribution.

entries.need: Find the keyword/ of a dataset.
entries.label: keyword/
usage_notes: This property contains a keyword or tag describing the Dataset.

entries.need: Find the landing page of a dataset.
entries.label: landing page
usage_notes: This property refers to a web page that provides access to the Dataset, its Distributions and/or additional information. It is intended to point to a landing page at the original data provider, not to a page on a site of a third party, such as an aggregator.

entries.need: Find the theme/ category of a dataset.
entries.label: theme/ category
usage_notes: This property refers to a category of the Dataset. A Dataset may be associated with multiple themes.

entries.need: Find the access rights of a dataset.
entries.label: access rights
usage_notes: This property refers to information that indicates whether the Dataset is open data, has access restrictions or is not public. A controlled vocabulary with three members (:public, :restricted, :non-public) will be created and maintained by the Publications Office of the EU.

entries.need: Find the frequency of a dataset.
entries.label: frequency
usage_notes: This property refers to the frequency at which the Dataset is updated.

entries.need: Find the conforms to of a dataset.
entries.label: conforms to
usage_notes: This property refers to an implementing rule or other specification.

entries.need: Find the description of a dataset.
entries.label: description
usage_notes: This property contains a free-text account of the Dataset. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description.

entries.need: Find the has version of a dataset.
entries.label: has version
usage_notes: This property refers to a related Dataset that is a version, edition, or adaptation of the described Dataset.

entries.need: Find the identifier of a dataset.
entries.label: identifier
usage_notes: This property contains the main identifier for the Dataset, e.g. the URI or other unique identifier in the context of the Catalogue.

entries.need: Find the is version of of a dataset.
entries.label: is version of
usage_notes: This property refers to a related Dataset of which the described Dataset is a version, edition, or adaptation.

entries.need: Find the release date of a dataset.
entries.label: release date
usage_notes: This property contains the date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the Dataset.

entries.need: Find the language of a dataset.
entries.label: language
usage_notes: This property refers to a language of the Dataset. This property can be repeated if there are multiple languages in the Dataset.

entries.need: Find the update/ of a dataset.
entries.label: update/
usage_notes: This property contains the most recent date on which the Dataset was changed or modified.

entries.need: Find the provenance of a dataset.
entries.label: provenance
usage_notes: This property contains a statement about the lineage of a Dataset.

entries.need: Find the publisher of a dataset.
entries.label: publisher
usage_notes: This property refers to an entity (organisation) responsible for making the Dataset available.

entries.need: Find the related resource of a dataset.
entries.label: related resource
usage_notes: This property refers to a related resource.

entries.need: Find the source of a dataset.
entries.label: source
usage_notes: This property refers to a related Dataset from which the described Dataset is derived.

entries.need: Find the spatial/ of a dataset.
entries.label: spatial/
usage_notes: This property refers to a geographic region that is covered by the Dataset.

entries.need: Find the temporal of a dataset.
entries.label: temporal
usage_notes: This property refers to a temporal period that the Dataset covers.

entries.need: Find the title of a dataset.
entries.label: title
usage_notes: This property contains a name given to the Dataset. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the name.

entries.need: Find the type of a dataset.
entries.label: type
usage_notes: This property refers to the type of the Dataset. A controlled vocabulary for the values has not been established.

entries.need: Find the documentation of a dataset.
entries.label: documentation
usage_notes: This property refers to a page or document about this Dataset.

entries.need: Find the version of a dataset.
entries.label: version
usage_notes: This property contains a version number or other version designation of the Dataset.

entries.need: Identify and describe a distribution.
entries.label: distribution

entries.need: Find the status of a distribution.
entries.label: status
usage_notes: This property refers to the maturity of the Distribution

entries.need: Find the access url of a distribution.
entries.label: access url
usage_notes: This property contains a URL that gives access to a Distribution of the Dataset. The resource at the access URL may contain information about how to get the Dataset.

entries.need: Find the byte size of a distribution.
entries.label: byte size
usage_notes: This property contains the size of a Distribution in bytes.

entries.need: Find the download url of a distribution.
entries.label: download url
usage_notes: This property contains a URL that is a direct link to a downloadable file in a given format.

entries.need: Find the media type of a distribution.
entries.label: media type
usage_notes: This property refers to the media type of the Distribution as defined in the official register of media types managed by IANA.

entries.need: Find the linked schemas of a distribution.
entries.label: linked schemas
usage_notes: This property refers to an established schema to which the described Distribution conforms.

entries.need: Find the description of a distribution.
entries.label: description
usage_notes: This property contains a free-text account of the Distribution. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description.

entries.need: Find the format of a distribution.
entries.label: format
usage_notes: This property refers to the file format of the Distribution.

entries.need: Find the release date of a distribution.
entries.label: release date
usage_notes: This property contains the date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the Distribution.

entries.need: Find the language of a distribution.
entries.label: language
usage_notes: This property refers to a language used in the Distribution. This property can be repeated if the metadata is provided in multiple languages.

entries.need: Find the licence of a distribution.
entries.label: licence
usage_notes: This property refers to the licence under which the Distribution is made available.

entries.need: Find the update/ of a distribution.
entries.label: update/
usage_notes: This property contains the most recent date on which the Distribution was changed or modified.

entries.need: Find the rights of a distribution.
entries.label: rights
usage_notes: This property refers to a statement that specifies rights associated with the Distribution.

entries.need: Find the title of a distribution.
entries.label: title
usage_notes: This property contains a name given to the Distribution. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description.

entries.need: Find the documentation of a distribution.
entries.label: documentation
usage_notes: This property refers to a page or document about this Distribution.

entries.need: Find the checksum of a distribution.
entries.label: checksum
usage_notes: This property provides a mechanism that can be used to verify that the contents of a distribution have not changed

entries.need: Identify and describe a license document.
entries.label: license document

entries.need: Find the licence type of a license document.
entries.label: licence type
usage_notes: This property refers to a type of licence, e.g. indicating ‘public domain’ or ‘royalties required’.

entries.need: Identify and describe a period of time.
entries.label: period of time

entries.need: Find the end date/time of a period of time.
entries.label: end date/time

entries.need: Find the start date/time of a period of time.
entries.label: start date/time

entries.need: Identify and describe an agent.
entries.label: agent

entries.need: Find the type of an agent.
entries.label: type
usage_notes: This property refers to a type of the agent that makes the Catalogue or Dataset available

entries.need: Find the name of an agent.
entries.label: name
usage_notes: This property contains a name of the agent. This property can be repeated for different versions of the name (e.g. the name in different languages)

entries.need: Identify and describe a concept.
entries.label: concept

entries.need: Find the preferred label of a concept.
entries.label: preferred label
usage_notes: This property contains a preferred label of the category. This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the label.

entries.need: Identify and describe a concept scheme.
entries.label: concept scheme

entries.need: Find the title of a concept scheme.
entries.label: title
usage_notes: This property contains a name of the category scheme. May be repeated for different versions of the name

entries.need: Identify and describe a checksum.
entries.label: checksum

entries.need: Find the algorithm of a checksum.
entries.label: algorithm
usage_notes: This property identifies the algorithm used to produce the subject Checksum. Currently, SHA-1 is the only supported algorithm. It is anticipated that other algorithms will be supported at a later time.

entries.need: Find the checksum value of a checksum.
entries.label: checksum value
usage_notes: This property provides a lower case hexadecimal encoded digest value produced using a specific algorithm.
